title: Module 1: Introduction to the Cloud
syllabusSummary: Foundational understanding of cloud computing, on-demand delivery, pay-as-you-go pricing, and shared responsibilities.

title: Module 2: Compute in the Cloud
syllabusSummary: Amazon EC2 virtual machines, instance sizing, vertical vs. horizontal scaling, Auto Scaling Groups, and Elastic Load Balancing.

title: Module 3: Exploring Compute Services
syllabusSummary: Serverless computing with AWS Lambda, container orchestration with Amazon ECS and Amazon EKS, and PaaS with AWS Elastic Beanstalk.

title: Module 4: Going Global
syllabusSummary: AWS Global Infrastructure: Regions, Availability Zones, Edge Locations with Amazon CloudFront, Route 53 DNS, and CloudFormation IaC.

title: Module 5: Networking
syllabusSummary: Amazon VPC, Public vs. Private Subnets, Internet Gateways, NAT Gateways, Route Tables, Security Groups, and Transit Gateways.

title: Module 6: Storage
syllabusSummary: Block storage (Amazon EBS), Object storage (Amazon S3), Shared File storage (Amazon EFS), and lifecycle archival.

title: Module 7: Databases
syllabusSummary: Relational databases (Amazon RDS), NoSQL key-value stores (Amazon DynamoDB), in-memory caching (ElastiCache Redis), and Redshift.

title: Module 8: AI/ML and Data Analytics
syllabusSummary: Real-time data streaming (Amazon Kinesis), data warehousing (Amazon Redshift), and machine learning inference (Amazon SageMaker).

title: Module 9: Security
syllabusSummary: Shared Responsibility Model, AWS IAM least-privilege roles, AWS WAF firewall shields, and AWS KMS encryption.

title: Module 10: Monitoring, Compliance, and Governance
syllabusSummary: Observability and metrics with Amazon CloudWatch, API audit logging with AWS CloudTrail, and automated SNS incident alerts.

title: Module 11: Pricing and Support
syllabusSummary: AWS pricing models, eliminating idle/unwired compute waste, right-sizing oversized instances, and FinOps cost optimization.

title: Module 12: Migrating to the AWS Cloud
syllabusSummary: The 6 Rs of Cloud Migration, live database replication with AWS DMS, and zero-downtime hybrid DNS cutovers.

title: Module 13: Well-Architected Solutions
syllabusSummary: The 6 Pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework: Operational Excellence, Security, Reliability, Performance, Cost, and Sustainability.
